title: Container
description: One container: status, restarts, CPU, memory against its limit, network, disk, logs by level, top errors, and API latency from request logs when the app writes them.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: Any running container on this Docker host.

list.name: lang
list.label: Language
list.description: container.lang label of the container: picks the Runtime row.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Throttled = the container wanted more CPU than its limit allows: requests get slower.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set = what counts against the limit (OOM kill at the limit). Cache can be dropped by the kernel.

defaults.noValue: cAdvisor does not report processes on this host (needs --enable_metrics=process)

targets.expr: container:="$container" level:(error OR fatal OR panic) | unpack_logfmt fields (msg, err, error) keep_original_fields | format if (msg:"") "<_msg>" as msg | stats by (msg, err, error) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 15

(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", container="$container", status=~"5.."}[5m])) or sum(rate(vector_frontend_http_requests_total{container="$container", status_class="5xx"}[5m]))) / (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", container="$container"}[5m])) or sum(rate(vector_frontend_http_requests_total{container="$container"}[5m]))) * 100

(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", container="$container", status=~"4.."}[5m])) or sum(rate(vector_frontend_http_requests_total{container="$container", status_class="4xx"}[5m]))) / (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", container="$container"}[5m])) or sum(rate(vector_frontend_http_requests_total{container="$container"}[5m]))) * 100

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: Frontends: needs rt=$request_time in the nginx log format.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", container="$container"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vector_frontend_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{container="$container"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Endpoints (slowest p95 first)
panels.description: Backends: Beyla (beyla/beyla.yml) or the app's own /metrics. Frontends: see Web pages below.

targets.expr: container:="$container" | extract "<_> - <_> [<_>] \"<method> <path> <_>\" <status> <bytes> " | filter path:!"" | stats by (path) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Top 404s
panels.description: Broken links and missing assets (.js / .css / images / fonts break the page). Empty: No access lines

targets.expr: container:="$container" | extract "<_> - <_> [<_>] \"<method> <path> <_>\" <status> <bytes> " | filter status:=404 | stats by (path) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20

container:="$container" | extract "<_> - <_> [<_>] \"<method> <path> <_>\" <status> <bytes> \"<referer>\" \"<agent>\"" | filter referer:!"-" referer:!"" | stats by (referer) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 15

panels.title: Humans vs bots (requests)
panels.description: Bots = crawlers, scripts and monitors (blackbox probes count as bots).

targets.expr: container:="$container" | extract "<_> - <_> [<_>] \"<method> <path> <_>\" <status> <bytes> \"<referer>\" \"<agent>\"" | format if (agent:~"(?i)bot|crawl|spider|slurp|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|headless|monitor|blackbox|uptime") "bot" as kind | format if (!agent:~"(?i)bot|crawl|spider|slurp|curl|wget|python|go-http|java/|okhttp|headless|monitor|blackbox|uptime") "human" as kind | stats by (kind) count()

panels.title: Clients that gave up (499)
panels.description: The browser closed the connection before the answer: the page was too slow. Empty: No access lines

targets.expr: container:="$container" | extract "<_> - <_> [<_>] \"<method> <path> <_>\" <status> <bytes> " | filter status:=499 | stats by (path) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20

panels.title: GC time (share of wall time)
panels.description: Time spent collecting garbage per second. Above 10% the app is starving for memory.

panels.title: Concurrency
panels.description: Node.js: event loop lag above 100ms = the app is blocked. Go: goroutines growing forever = leak.
